title: Omarchy 4.5: floating windows, 50 languages, and Macs
summary: Over 740 pull requests from more than 180 contributors in twelve weeks, with a native installer for M1, M2, M3 and Neo MacBooks.

topics.angle: The release everything after it builds on.
The day the Mac installer shipped.

claims.text: 4.5 installs natively on M1, M2, M3 and Neo MacBooks.
Over 740 pull requests were merged from more than 180 contributors.
4.5 is the first release with an ARM ISO, with preliminary support for NVIDIA’s DGX Spark and N1X.
